content: FLPoison (SoK: Benchmarking Poisoning Attacks and Defenses in FL, arXiv:2502.03801, 2025) is the current standard FL poisoning benchmark (15 attacks, 17 defenses) but its published metrics are accuracy-drop and TPR/FPR style; no graded/continuous target-normalized ASR metric like clip(drop/target,0,1) was found in the repo README or paper abstract.
